newsitem.title: USA: Siebert Financial sees higher Q4 costs.
newsitem.headline: Siebert Financial sees higher Q4 costs.

text.p: Discount brokerage Siebert Financial Corp said on Monday it expects "substantial additional compensation and overhead costs in the fourth quarter and 1997" from the formation of its municipal investment banking business.

"There can be no assurance that the company will generate sufficient additional revenue to cover such expenses and the results for the year to date may not be representative for the full year of 1996 or 1997," the company said in a statement with its nine month results.
Siebert's shares fell 1-1/4 to 9-1/2 on volume of 400 shares.

Siebert Financial formed the Siebert Brandford Shank Division, which added 26 municipal investment bankers to the firm and opened six related offices from the formation of the group on October 1, 1996.
The firm also opened three new retail offices, Siebert said.
In the third quarter, commission revenue growth slowed "significantly" in the third quarter of 1996 compared to the prior year, Siebert said.
